_authority: AUTHORED pin. The NAME SET is DERIVED from co_names and must not be hand-edited; the tokens are the expectation. An uncovered reachable name and a pinned unreachable name both fail closed, so this file cannot drift away from the code in either direction.

_environment_dispositions.MUST_BE_UNSET: the variable must not be present in any run
_environment_dispositions.MUST_RESOLVE_IN_TREE: RETIRED at Gate 4N-I28AI. Gate 4N-I28AH proved that 'inside the repository' is not authorization: an in-tree decoy cut the enforced mandatory set from twelve nodes to one with every layer clean. The registry now has exactly one legal location and the override is MUST_BE_UNSET.

_how_to_regenerate: PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/executed_state_provenance.py --emit. Re-pinning is a decision, never a refresh: a drift means the executing state changed.
_purpose: Pin the load-bearing STATE that the protected modules' critical callables read, so a state-only mutation with byte-identical code is refused.
_trust_boundary: This file is itself load-bearing state; executed_state_provenance.STATE_CONTRACT binds it by content.
_why_this_file_exists: Gate 4N-I28AF finding ADV-I28AF-01: executed-code provenance bound the code and not what the code reads. Rebinding one global cut the mandatory node set from 12 to 1 while every provenance layer reported clean.

names.REGISTERED_HELPERS: VALUE:{'pytest.approx': 'numeric tolerance comparison, used inside a comparison', 'pytest.fail': 'fails unconditionally when reached', 'pytest.raises': 'raises if the expected exception is not raised'}

assertion_contracts.why_load_bearing: the contract registry and the reachability constants decide whether a gutted assertion is detected; retargeting REGISTRY would make every contract vacuous

cache_authority.why_load_bearing: GATE 4N-I28AR. cache_authority is the seventh bootstrap layer and the only one that binds a value the process DERIVED rather than code or state read from disk. Its own state must be pinned for the same reason every other layer's is: a layer that can be re-pointed at different data decides nothing.

names.DOCKER_STEERING_CATEGORIES: VALUE:{'TLS variables': ('DOCKER_CERT_PATH', 'DOCKER_TLS', 'DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY'), 'a defined Docker context': ('DOCKER_CONTEXT'), 'steering flags': ('--host', '-H', '--context', '--config', '--tls', '--tlsverify', '--tlscacert', '--tlscert', '--tlskey')}

docker_boundary.why_load_bearing: GATE 4N-I28AT. docker_boundary is the ninth bootstrap layer and the sole adjudicator of the Docker execution boundary. Under the external-CI assumption model the daemon is explicitly NOT verified, so this layer is the only thing preventing a repository-controlled steering mechanism from redirecting Docker away from the assumed daemon. Its state must be pinned for the same reason every other layer's is: a layer that can be re-pointed at a different policy, a different call-site inventory or a different set of steering dispositions decides nothing.

executable_inventory.why_load_bearing: the derived executable inventory and its policy decide which external binaries must be bound; retargeting either reinstates ADV-I28AJ-01

executed_code_provenance.why_load_bearing: load-bearing state for a protected control

executed_state_provenance.why_load_bearing: STATE_CONTRACT is this control's own pin; retargeting it would let the control approve any state

external_executable_trust.why_load_bearing: POLICY and the steering-variable tuples decide which binaries are trusted and which environment is fatal; widening either reinstates ADV-I28AH-02

npm_authority.why_load_bearing: GATE 4N-I28AS. npm_authority is the eighth bootstrap layer and the sole authority for the npm -> Node execution chain; its verdict decides whether a release-blocking job may run npm. Its state must be pinned for the same reason every other layer's is: a layer that can be re-pointed at a different policy, a different installation root or a different set of manager-selected versions decides nothing.

pytest_config_contract.why_load_bearing: the configuration baseline and the collection-remover list decide which configuration sources are refused

pytest_session_guard.why_load_bearing: the guard's authority comes entirely from REGISTRY and the helpers that resolve it; Gate 4N-I28AF rebound REGISTRY alone and cut the mandatory set from 12 nodes to 1 with every code object byte-identical

registry_authority.why_load_bearing: CANONICAL_REGISTRY, BASELINE and OVERRIDE_ENV decide which file is authoritative and what it is compared against; retargeting any of them reinstates ADV-I28AH-01

signalnest_bootstrap.why_load_bearing: PROTECTED_SET names the modules that get verified at all; retargeting it silently shrinks the protected universe

site_taxonomy.why_load_bearing: release_roots decides whether an executable may remain unbound; production/ci_release site sets are the universes every gate reconciles

startup_policy.why_load_bearing: POLICY is the authored startup classification; retargeting it would let a hostile startup surface be adjudicated against an attacker's policy

names.WORKFLOW_COVERAGE_MARKER: VALUE:'NOT_ADJUDICATED — deferred to Gate 4N-I28BG (ADV-I28AX-ARCH-01 part B)'

docker_assurance_state.why_load_bearing: the authoritative Docker assurance state, governed cache, and session integration (Gate 4N-I28BF-B1)

workflow_assurance.why_load_bearing: the reusable publish-workflow verifier (Gate 4N-I28BG-B1): it binds the built image digest, resolved immutable tags, and freshly re-derived source identity to the authorized workflow/job/authorization window at build and push time

workflow_graph_validator.why_load_bearing: the static publication-workflow graph validator (Gate 4N-I28BG-B1): it proves the ordering, fail-closed propagation, and no-bypass wiring that makes the runtime verifier load-bearing
